conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: C2 not met - early silicone Dimethicone (8), cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (13) and pearlizing Glycol Distearate (16) are present, but no deliberate humectant from the closed C2 list (no Glycerin, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium PCA, Urea, Sorbitol or Betaine; R11). Further routes: Amodimethicone (12), Hydrolyzed Keratin (6), PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (5).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The other three C2 elements plus amodimethicone and protein are present; the missing humectant route is the counter-signal.
